caption: A metal spoon rests across a stand with its bowl just above a candle flame, and black soot builds up on the underside where the flame touches.

sa.check: A metal spoon rests across a stand with its bowl above a candle flame.
A black patch appears on the spoon's underside.
The patch grows darker and wider.
The patch is where the flame licks the metal.
The rest of the spoon stays bright.

pc.expect: The black patch appears only where the flame touches the metal and grows from there.
pc.fail: The patch appears on the spoon's handle away from the flame; or the flame licks the spoon and its underside stays bright to the end of the clip; or the patch appears on the spoon's upper face while its underside stays clean; or the whole spoon blackens evenly while the flame licks one spot.

pc.expect: The patch only darkens and widens and does not fade while the flame plays on it.
pc.fail: The black patch fades back to bright metal with the flame still under it; or the patch shrinks; or the patch darkens and lightens in turn; or the soot lifts off by itself and leaves the metal clean.

pc.expect: The flame points upward at the spoon's bowl and any smoke rises past it.
pc.fail: The flame points downward away from the spoon; or hangs below the candle; or the smoke sinks and pools under the spoon; or the smoke pours downward from the spoon's underside.

pc.expect: The spoon stays rigid metal that takes the soot as a loose black film, and the candle keeps its shape with a wax pool.
pc.fail: The spoon sags or melts over the flame; or the spoon's metal bubbles; or the soot sets as a hard shell that keeps the spoon's shape once the spoon moves away; or the candle's body slumps as a whole.

pc.expect: One spoon on one stand over one candle; the spoon stays in place and the candle stays below it.
pc.fail: A second spoon appears; or the spoon vanishes; or the spoon passes through the stand; or the flame detaches from the wick and floats up to the spoon.

pc.expect: The stand, the candle's holder and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stand changes shape; or the holder changes colour; or items around the stand rearrange.
